text: Hello, sorry to be ringing, well texting, at this hour, I'm her stepmam so I'm not always sure what's normal for her. She's 3 and her temp's been up all evening, 38.2 the last time I took it. Her eczema's after flaring up again as well, dry itchy patches on the backs of her knees and her elbows and she's scratching away at them, that part's nothing new really. The thing that's bothering me is her colour. I think she's gone a bit grey looking, sort of pale and kind of blotchy across her legs and tummy, like a mottled look, and her lips look a bit bluish to me but maybe that's the light in the bedroom, I'm not sure. I put the big light on and I still think she looks a funny colour. Her dad's on nights and I didn't want to be worrying him if it's nothing. I'm probably overreacting, sorry, I just don't know what I'm looking at.
